# Dushanbe Soft

> Dushanbe Soft is an IT company based in Dushanbe, Tajikistan, founded in 2017. It develops websites, mobile apps, CRM/ERP systems and digital products for businesses and government organizations in Tajikistan and Central Asia. The website is available in Russian (default), Tajik (/tj) and English (/en).

Contacts: phone +992 901 000 535, email dushanbesoft@gmail.com, Telegram https://t.me/992901000535. Address: Dushanbe, Republic of Tajikistan.

Private Enterprise "Dushanbe Soft" was awarded a contract (TDFP-NS-RFQ-03, 2026) under the World Bank-financed Tajikistan Digital Foundations Project (P506611): https://projects.worldbank.org/en/projects-operations/procurement-detail/OP00455715

Notable projects: the official website of the President of the Republic of Tajikistan (president.tj), the Digital Tajikistan e-government portal, OTT streaming platforms for Somon TV, the OnlinePay acquiring platform, the ZudSMS bulk SMS platform and the LiveChat TJ online chat service.

## Services

- [IT services overview](https://dushanbe-soft.tj/en/services): all services in one place
- [Website development](https://dushanbe-soft.tj/en/services/web-development): corporate websites, online stores, portals and web apps (Next.js, React, Laravel)
- [Mobile app development](https://dushanbe-soft.tj/en/services/mobile-app-development): iOS and Android apps with Flutter, Telegram bots and Mini Apps
- [CRM and ERP development](https://dushanbe-soft.tj/en/services/crm-erp-development): custom business automation systems
- [SMS gateway and bulk SMS](https://dushanbe-soft.tj/en/services/sms-gateway): ZudSMS platform and REST API for OTP codes and notifications to all operators in Tajikistan
- [UI/UX design](https://dushanbe-soft.tj/en/services/ui-ux-design): interface design and design systems in Figma
- [API integration](https://dushanbe-soft.tj/en/services/api-integration): payment systems, banks, 1C, government services
- [Cybersecurity](https://dushanbe-soft.tj/en/services/cybersecurity): security audits, penetration testing, DDoS protection
- [Website support](https://dushanbe-soft.tj/en/services/website-support): maintenance plans, backups, monitoring
